sources.summary: This issue traces almost two decades of work by the international firm Moneo Brock, founded in New York in 1993 by Belén Moneo and Jeff Brock, and based in Madrid since 2002. Across 320 pages, the publication presents a selection of works built between 2007 and 2026, ranging from urban infrastructures and educational facilities to leisure spaces, domestic architecture, and object design, with projects realized in Spain, Mexico, Colombia, and the Dominican Republic.
